The Chinese characters for Gloria

As a transliteration, Gloria is usually written 格洛丽亚 (Gé luò lì yà). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

格
Gé
pattern, standard
洛
luò
the Luo river
丽
lì
beautiful
亚
yà
Asia, second

Origin and meaning

Gloria comes from Latin and means “glory”.

About the name Gloria

A Latin word for 'glory', and the name of the singer Gloria Estefan.

As a gift or a tattoo

Because it means “glory”, a Gloria calligraphy print makes a thoughtful gift for someone who loves the name or its meaning.
